title: Two problems for threshold cascades of interacting diffusions on unimodular random trees: front propagation with a Bramson correction, and the continuous-type limit theory
summary: Companion to arXiv:2608.XXXXX, which reduces threshold cascades of coupled Ornstein-Uhlenbeck diffusions on graphs converging Benjamini-Schramm to a unimodular Galton-Watson tree, unconditionally in a dissipative regime, to a finite-type Galton-Watson process. Two problems are left open there; we formulate both precisely, supply the analytic framework, and prove partial theorems. First, front propagation.
